instruction: Query the OQMD database to count the total number of entries containing Fe and O (element_set=Fe,O), and save the total count to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_3.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
